name: event-stream / Copay

name: Octopus Scanner

name: SolarWinds SUNBURST

name: XcodeGhost

name: CCleaner (Piriform)

name: PHP Git Source Tampering

name: Codecov Bash Uploader

name: Travis CI Secret Leakage

name: GitHub Actions Template Injection

name: ASUS Live Update (ShadowHammer)

name: 3CX DesktopApp

name: Webmin Backdoor
